GenAiPromptTemplate.description: Used to generate a title from a piece of text or an uploaded image of a note.

templateVersions.content:
Purpose: Generate a concise, normalized, high-quality title for the note Output: ONLY the title (no formatting, no extra text)
📥 1. INPUTS You are analyzing: An uploaded image of handwritten meeting notes Optional additional text provided by the end user (may or may not be present), entered here: {!$Input:Text} If {!$Input:Text} is blank, empty, or null, rely only on the uploaded image.
🔎 2. CONTEXT This is Prompt 1 of 3 in a standardized, multi-prompt Salesforce solution used to process handwritten meeting notes. All three prompts operate on the same uploaded image and the same optional user-provided text. Each prompt has a single, well-defined responsibility and produces a separate output used downstream in Salesforce Flow. Your responsibility in Prompt 1 is to generate a clean, professional, consistently formatted title that clearly communicates the purpose or theme of the meeting. Treat the handwritten notes and {!$Input:Text} as a single combined source of truth. If {!$Input:Text} is empty, do not reference or infer from it.
📏 3. INSTRUCTIONS (MUST FOLLOW) ✅ Output Rules (STRICT) Output ONLY the title text Maximum 200 characters One single line No bullets, emojis, labels, quotes, or formatting ✅ Title Normalization Rules (REQUIRED) The title must always follow this structure: <Current Date> - <Descriptive Title> Always use the current date (date of execution) Date format must be: YYYY-MM-DD Do not extract, infer, or reference a meeting date from the notes ✅ Descriptive Title Quality Rules (GUARDRAILS) Must clearly reflect the primary purpose or topic of the meeting Must be specific enough to be meaningful in a list view Must use professional, CRM-appropriate language Must not be generic (e.g., “Meeting Notes”, “Client Call”, “Discussion”) If details are limited, choose a conservative but descriptive title rather than a vague one. 🚫 Do NOT Do not include the body notes or next steps Do not invent names, dates, or outcomes Do not explain your reasoning Do not include markdown, emojis, or unnecessary punctuation

Purpose: Generate a concise, accurate title for the note Output: ONLY the title text
📥 1. INPUTS You are analyzing: An uploaded image of handwritten meeting notes Optional additional text provided by the end user: {!$Input:Text} Treat all inputs as a single source of truth.
🔎 2. CONTEXT This is Prompt 1 of 3 in a standardized Salesforce Flow solution. Your responsibility is to generate a clear, professional title that reflects the provided content only if a meaningful title can be derived.
📏 3. INSTRUCTIONS (STRICT — MUST FOLLOW) ✅ Output Rules Output ONLY the title text One single line Maximum 200 characters No formatting, labels, quotes, emojis, or extra text
✅ Title Creation Rules The title must be derived only from explicitly provided content Prefer specificity when a clear topic, client, or purpose is stated If content is vague, keep the title general and professional
🚫 ZERO-INFERENCE RULE (CRITICAL) If the inputs contain only: A name A date A partial phrase Placeholder or identifier text and no clear meeting topic: 👉 DO NOT invent or infer a title Instead: Output the provided text verbatim or near-verbatim Do not embellish or reinterpret
🚫 ABSOLUTE PROHIBITIONS Do not invent meeting purposes Do not infer topics, goals, or discussions Do not normalize, rewrite, or “improve” sparse input Do not explain reasoning 🔒 FINAL ENFORCEMENT RULE If a meaningful title cannot be confidently derived from the input, output the safest minimal version of the provided text.
